This meticulously designed and newly renovated 3-bedroom/3-bathroom property boasts a prime location, which is just a short stroll away from the pristine white sands and crystal-clear waters. Ideal for families and couples alike, Beechwood Villas promises an unforgettable beach getaway. This charming 30A retreat boasts an array of top-notch amenities ensuring utmost comfort and enjoyment during your stay. Take a refreshing dip in one of the two sparkling swimming pools, with one heated seasonally, or engage in friendly competition on the illuminated shuffleboard or tennis courts! A little play area will delight our smallest guests! The vibrant atmosphere of Seagrove Beach awaits just moments away, offering an eclectic mix of boutiques, restaurants and outdoor activities. Explore the natural wonders of Deer Lake State Park and Eastern Lake, or embark on a scenic bike ride along the Timpoochee Trail to uncover hidden gems. Indulge in local culinary delights, ranging from classic favorites at Cafe Thirty-A to fresh sushi and live music at Old Florida Fish House. With Seaside and Rosemary Beach nearby, endless shopping, dining and entertainment option ensure there's never a dull moment. Discover the charm of Beachwood Villas where relaxation, convenience and adventure converge seamlessly. Whether you're planning a romantic retreat, a family vacation or a group getaway, this inviting condo will provide the perfect home base for your next coastal adventure along 30A.NotesThe clubhouse will be closed until May 1st due to construction.
